$comment: The action object for one ReAct turn. RFC-0001 §6.1 and §6.3. Flat by design: no nesting, every string bounded. Note `required` lists every string field, including ones the chosen tool does not use. That is deliberate and measured: Ollama's constrained decoding enforces the top-level `required` list and nothing else useful, so it is the only way to guarantee an `edit` carries its `replace`. Irrelevant fields come back as empty strings and the harness ignores them. See prompts/README.md.

reasoning.$comment: Two sentences. Bounded because latency is output length and this is paid on every turn.

search.$comment: The bound that stops the failure observed on the very first request ever sent to the model: an unbounded string run until it hit the token cap. 3000 characters is roughly 75 lines of Rust.
